title: Senior Software Engineer
summary: 10 years delivering production software across SaaS, ecommerce, education, identity, and customer-facing enterprise platforms, with emphasis on scalable architectures and scalable and resilient systems. Technical ownership spans UI applications, backend services, APIs, data workflows, system integrations, and high-availability production engineering with measurable business impact. Autonomous execution and accountable delivery across collaborative engineering environments, from technical design through implementation, testing, deployment, and operational support. Strong command of SDLC and Software Development Life Cycle practices, Git-based version control, engineering standards, code quality standards, automated testing, and industry-standard practices. Builds data-rich interfaces and visualization workflows using SQL, .NET Core, D3.js, Grafana, and API-driven architectures while integrating AI capabilities and agent-oriented workflows where appropriate. Drives continuous improvement through performance tuning, observability, incident analysis, maintainable architecture, and reliable delivery across customer-facing systems and internal platforms.
